findings.title: Conclusion implies a primary-result check despite zero checked claims
findings.page_quote: The claim check (reproduction.claim_check) compares the page's statements about the primary result with this object; recorded as outside its scope: verbatim source quotations; external comparator prose.
findings.why: The topic-specific wording implies its primary-result statements were checked, but the recorded check includes zero claims and zero outcome results. Listing only the prose exclusions obscures that limitation.
findings.fix: Render the recorded check counts and state that no outcome-result claims were checked for this build.
